the_gap_closed.exact_gap_verbatim: no binding from CandidateClassApplicabilityReceipt/replay identity to PositionedSubjectPossibilityModelRule.source_universe_refs or exact query-source validation
the_gap_closed.now: bind_service_applicability_to_f8_scope reads one exact adopted CandidateClassApplicabilityReceipt, validates the receipt's authority label, request/receipt grain, service grain, candidate class and release grain, and constrains the F8 model rule's source scope to lie inside the positively admitted set. evaluate_bound_positioned_subject_possibility then validates one exact F8 query source at one exact release and hands query/rule/evidence to the ADOPTED, UNMODIFIED F8 evaluator.

inputs_carried_exact: receipt identity and replay identity (applicability_receipt_id, applicability_receipt_replay_identity)
per-source admission provenance (admission_authority_ref, admission_provenance_refs, release_identity_ref, bound_to_requested_release)
service / target / population / geography / time / release grain as carried by the receipt request_key plus the bound release_identity_ref
already-bound target-use permission refs (carried as INPUTS, never re-issued)
separate lifecycle/currentness result ONLY when a currentness claim is actually requested

positive_powers_exactly_two.effect: validates ONE exact F8 query source against a positive admitted entry in an exact applicability receipt, and returns its admission provenance
positive_powers_exactly_two.returns: a per-source validation mapping carrying admitted=true, the public applicability state, the admission provenance, and explicit not_conditioning / not_a_selection_among_sources / no_ranking_or_priority_implied flags
positive_powers_exactly_two.never: chooses a substitute source, and never returns a ranked or preferred source

positive_powers_exactly_two.effect: exposes the COMPLETE UNRANKED admitted source_universe_refs set for independent source-indexed F8 evaluation
positive_powers_exactly_two.coverage_rule: exposing the SET is itself an exhaustive claim, so COMPLETE candidate_class_coverage is required in EVERY binding mode, not only in EXHAUSTIVE_UNRANKED_SET
positive_powers_exactly_two.never: aggregates, pools, orders, weights or reorders

no_third_power.structural_evidence: the binding dataclass exposes exactly two source-touching methods that return values (the two powers) and seven methods that raise. The court pins both the set of returning methods and the set of raising methods.

f8_law_preserved.drift_guard: if F8 ever reports a different algorithm_id or model_rule_id, bind and evaluate both refuse with F8_ALGORITHM_NOT_EXACT_CONDITIONAL_LOOKUP / F8_MODEL_RULE_NOT_RECOGNISED rather than silently binding against a changed law
f8_law_preserved.f8_owner_verified_by: the court runs git hash-object on the F8 module and compares to the HQ208-recorded blob; it is not merely imported
f8_law_preserved.pass_through: evaluate_bound_positioned_subject_possibility passes the caller's own query, rule and evidence objects to evaluate_positioned_subject_possibility. It never edits, reorders, widens, narrows, reweights or retargets them, and never inspects or alters conditioners.
f8_law_preserved.the_selection_not_transformation_trap: narrowing the admitted set can change WHICH pre-materialized slice F8 selects. That is output SELECTION, not output TRANSFORMATION. The court pins this directly: the same evidence slice yields byte-identical exact_geometry and the same result_state under both a wide and a narrowed binding.

enforcement: the binding exposes no method that constructs, adds, drops, widens or re-points a ConditionerBinding

the binding never reads a conditioner attribute; the court proves this by AST scan for conditioner_bindings, retained_conditioner_ids, effective_time_or_interval, geometry, uncertainty_state, raw_support, walkback_steps and positive_proxy_authority_refs, and requires the touched set to be EMPTY
eligibility_is_not_conditioning.consistency_with_the_adopted_owner: the applicability owner's DECISION_MATRIX sets may_condition_F8 = False on every decision including ADMITTED; this binder does not create a path around that.

adopted_owners_not_modified.note: no wiring change to any adopted owner was needed. The commission permitted one only if exact implementation proved it unavoidable, and it was not: the binding reads the adopted public surface (receipt accessors, rule.source_universe_refs, rule.rule_hash) and constructs nothing inside another owner's namespace.

explicit_nondependencies_honoured.c1: not waited for. No C1 analytical/joint/multi-arity claim is made. The three C1 analytical modules remain absent and are not imported.
explicit_nondependencies_honoured.f7: not waited for. No positive temporal comparison, pressure or temporal-conditioning claim is made. TEMPORAL_COMPARABILITY_OR_PRESSURE is a refused purpose.
explicit_nondependencies_honoured.why_they_are_genuinely_unnecessary_here: this seam binds a static exact-release source scope. It reads no temporal comparison, computes no delta, and constructs no trajectory, so neither C1 composition nor F7 temporal constitution is on its path.

binding_grain.granularity: one binding per (service_request_set_identity, candidate_class_ref, release_identity_ref, exact F8 model rule)
binding_grain.per_source_grain: every admitted source is carried as a SEPARATE source-indexed entry with its own provenance row; multiple admitted sources are never merged
binding_grain.cardinality: the admitted set cardinality is explicitly NOT a sample size
